content.text:
Dear Parents, Families, and Friends,

You are warmly invited to our Spring School Concert!

**Date:** Thursday, April 17
**Time:** 6:30 PM
**Location:** Riverside Elementary School Auditorium

Come hear our students perform songs, instrumental pieces, and a special choir finale. Every performer has worked hard all term, and we would love to see you cheer them on.

Refreshments will be served in the lobby after the show.

Please arrive by 6:15 PM so we can seat everyone before the program begins. Admission is free, but seating is limited, so kindly RSVP to the front office by April 10.

We look forward to celebrating with you!

Warm regards,

Ms. Elena Ruiz
Music Department
Riverside Elementary School
